description: This file defines a base activity class for an Android application, providing common setup such as initializing logging. It extends FragmentActivity and sets up logging facilities in the onStart lifecycle method.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base activity class that handles common plumbing tasks, notably logging initialization, for other activities that extend it.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created; currently only calls super implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity becomes visible; calls super and initializes logging.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain using LogWrapper and a tag for identification, and writes a 'Ready' message.
